record.reason: The paper derives depth- and context-aware theoretical bounds for choosing RoPE base values in long-context LLMs and checks predictions across model families. It informs context-extension design but does not report a direct inference compute/latency reduction.
record.title: Rotary Positional Embeddings as Phase Modulation: Theoretical Bounds on the RoPE Base for Long-Context Transformers
